svg.text: Each handoff names both people in text with chips and an arrow; the brief is Markdown, folded; the footer, not the card, opens the turn.

Done. Lint, build and tests pass; see
Make Activity and Handoffs readable, like
Header: from chip and name → to chip and name, both in text; the time in ink-muted mono (was faint).
The brief's first heading becomes the card's title and isn't repeated; the rest is compact Markdown.
Folded at 8 lines: ‘Show all · 38 lines’. Links in the brief work: the card is an article, not a button.
The footer is the button that opens the turn's Activity: 36px row, 44px hit area; shown focused.
Said to the coordinator from a turn: ‘From turn-5’. 6: Said to you, no turn: no footer, nothing to open.
Phone: from → to on one line (names truncate at 120px); the footer drops duration and counts.
